statement:
by
  classical
  let hit := fun {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (s b : ℝ) =>
    s<b ∧ b<1 ∧ (χ ≠ 1 ∨ (b:ℂ) ≠ 1) ∧ DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ (b:ℂ)=0
  exact ∃ k C : ℝ, 0<k ∧ 0<C ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp 64≤x →
    let u := Real.sqrt (Real.log x)
    let s := 1-k/u
    ∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q], (Q:ℝ)≤Real.exp u → ∃ (b : ℝ) (d : ℕ), d≤Q ∧
    ∀ (q : ℕ) [NeZero q], q≤Q →
      let S := @Finset.filter (DirichletCharacter ℂ q) (fun χ => hit χ s b)
        (fun _ => Classical.propDecidable _) Finset.univ
      S.card=(if d∣q then 1 else 0) ∧
      (∀ χ ∈ S, χ.IsQuadratic ∧ χ ≠ 1 ∧ χ.conductor=d ∧
        analyticOrderNatAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) (b:ℂ)=1) ∧
      ∀ a : ℕ, a<q → a.Coprime q →
        let ε := (∑ χ ∈ S, χ (a:ZMod q)⁻¹).re
        let ψ := ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Ioc 0 ⌊x⌋₊).filter (fun n => n%q=a), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n
        let R := |ψ-(x-ε*(x^b/b))/q.totient|
        (if d∣q then ε=1 ∨ ε= -1 else ε=0) ∧ R≤C*x*Real.exp (-(k*u)) ∧
        ((q:ℝ)≤Real.exp (k*u/2) → R≤C*(x/q.totient)*Real.exp (-(k*u/2)))

plain_statement.zh: 带同一例外导子的等差数列素数定理与次指数模数上的统一误差
plain_statement.en: A uniform prime number theorem in progressions with a common exceptional conductor

brief.zh: 设 u=√log x。对 x≥exp(64)、Q≤exp(u)，存在同一实数 β 和整数 d≤Q。对每个正模数 q≤Q，Re s>1−k/u 处被选中的 β 恰在 d 整除 q 时由一个非主二次特征承载，且为单零点。对既约剩余类 a，ψ(x;q,a) 的主项为 (x−ε x^β/β)/φ(q)。ε 在承载层为该特征在 a 逆元的取值 ±1，在其他层为零。绝对误差至多 Cx exp(−ku)，当 q≤exp(ku/2) 时至多 C(x/φ(q))exp(−ku/2)。d=0 表示没有承载层。
brief.en: Put u=sqrt(log x). For x≥exp(64) and Q≤exp(u), choose one real beta and one conductor d≤Q. At each positive level q≤Q the selected zero above 1−k/u has one nonprincipal quadratic carrier precisely when d divides q, and has analytic order one. On every reduced residue class the main term of psi(x;q,a) is (x−epsilon x^beta/beta)/phi(q). The sign is the carrier evaluated at the inverse of a, and is zero on other levels. The error is at most Cx exp(−ku), improving to C(x/phi(q))exp(−ku/2) for q≤exp(ku/2). Set d=0 when no level carries the correction.
